learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to read and understand easy texts.
Will be able to write letters with simple sentences and introduce themselves and others.
Will be able to listen to and understand daily conversations at a beginner level; introduce and express themselves and others with simple sentences.
Will be able to recognize and use beginner-level vocabulary related to daily life.
Technology Use: They will acquire independent study skills by completing internet assignments given to them through technology, and will be able to access all course materials via Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Developing skills to express oneself with appropriate time structures, especially expressing daily needs
Reinforcing learned structures with simple reading texts and listening activities
Subjects, creating dialogues in class grammar
Word cards, personal information question-answer practice
Listening practice / video personal information question-answer
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
